notes: Added missing schema/contract, core backend logic, API integration, and end-to-end validation stories to complete explainability layer.

EVAL-F5-S161.title: Define Explainability Schema Contract
EVAL-F5-S161.description: Create a standardized explainability schema (e.g., Pydantic model) defining required fields: source, meaning, limitations, and optional metadata. Ensure compatibility with provider and clinical trial signal structures.

EVAL-F5-S162.title: Attach Explainability to Provider Signals
EVAL-F5-S162.description: Extend provider_detail_service outputs to include explainability metadata for each credential and verification signal, mapping raw fields (license, specialty, status, external links) to standardized explanations.

EVAL-F5-S163.title: Attach Explainability to Clinical Trial Signals
EVAL-F5-S163.description: Extend clinical_trials_service outputs to include explainability metadata for trial phase, status, eligibility, and summary fields, ensuring consistent interpretation guidance for users.

EVAL-F5-S164.title: Integrate Explainability into Evaluate Care Facade Responses
EVAL-F5-S164.description: Update evaluate_care_facade to aggregate explainability metadata alongside evaluation signals and ensure the API response structure consistently includes explainability objects for all returned entities.

EVAL-F5-S165.title: End-to-End Explainability Integration Test
EVAL-F5-S165.description: Implement integration tests validating that explainability metadata flows from domain services through the facade to the frontend-rendered chat output, ensuring completeness and schema adherence.

EVAL-F5.mitigation: Enforce strict schema contract and default fallback logic already defined to guarantee completeness.
